name: demo-rollover
description: Demo context rollover: a feature build closes two of four tasks, its context grows to ~77% of the window, and it ends its turn at the clean task boundary. The supervisor distills a handoff brief and continues the thread in a fresh session (which runs the scenario named by CLAUDE_SIM_SCENARIO, demo-rollover-successor in the live demo). If the rollover is refused, the next turn finishes the remaining tasks itself.

steps.text: Declaring the plan for porting the legacy reports.

args.summary: Port the four legacy SQL reports onto the event store.

input.content:
# Legacy reports
